attacks.argument: Loki's claim of a 38.5-62.5% loss in maize imports contradicts the confirmed net value loss of close to 40% when accounting for substitute supply from Vanir, indicating a miscalculation in the range presented.

The assertion that Tolan lost only 28.3-34.2% of its wheat imports is flawed, as the confirmed net value loss for Midgard wheat, which includes Vanir supply, is close to 40%, suggesting that Tolan's losses are likely underestimated.
Loki's claim that Midgard's wheat arrivals are only down 37.4-41.38% contradicts the preliminary customs figures indicating a significant drop below levels from a year earlier.

The claim regarding Midgard's maize import loss of 38.5-62.5% contradicts the confirmed data showing that Orvan's share of Midgard's grain imports has fallen significantly, indicating a more severe impact.
